Package com.kerosene.kfe.paymentexecution.adapters.in.scheduling

Class KfeOutboundConfirmationMonitor

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.paymentexecution.adapters.in.scheduling.KfeOutboundConfirmationMonitor
@Component @ConditionalOnProperty(name="kfe.network-monitor.enabled", havingValue="true", matchIfMissing=true) public class KfeOutboundConfirmationMonitor extends Object
Production confirmation monitor for on-chain outbounds and inbounds.

After broadcast (KfeExecutionTransactionHelper.recordOutboundBroadcast(java.util.UUID, java.util.UUID, java.util.UUID, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, long, java.util.UUID, java.lang.String)), funds remain LOCKED on the source wallet until this monitor observes minConfirmations on the blockchain txid, then settles the reserved debit.

UI contract: confirmation rings (0/6…6/6) must advance on every block even when settle fails or hangs. Conf updates run in a short REQUIRES_NEW TX before settle.
